summary: This bill requires the Attorney General, Secretary of Homeland Security, Postmaster General, and other relevant agencies to develop a strategy within 180 days to improve federal investigations of organized postal theft by enhancing information sharing and cooperation with state and local law enforcement, and mandates reports on this strategy and on private sector coordination.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on improving federal investigations and coordination among law enforcement agencies to combat organized postal theft. This directly relates to strengthening law enforcement efforts and prosecuting crimes, aligning with a stricter approach to justice.
